title.zh: 谷歌投资独立电影公司A24，达成AI合作伙伴关系
title.en: Google invests in independent movie studio A24 as part of a new AI partnership; sources say Google is investing ~$75M, roughly equal to Thrive's 2024 investment

summary.zh: 消息称谷歌投资约7500万美元，与Thrive 2024年的投资额相当。

title.zh: Getty Images与OpenAI签署授权协议，图片库将用于ChatGPT搜索和发现工具
title.en: Getty Images signs a licensing deal with OpenAI, letting its image library appear in ChatGPT's search and discovery tools; GETY jumps 90%+ and is down 10%+ YTD

summary.zh: GETY股价跳涨90%以上，但年初至今下跌超过10%。

title.zh: 中国将10家美国公司列入出口管制名单，并禁止政府采购46家美国公司产品
title.en: China adds 10 US companies, including MP Materials and Teal Drones, to its export controls and bans government purchases from 46 US companies, including Anduril

title.zh: 五眼联盟警告AI模型可能在数月内威胁政府和企业，呼吁领导人立即行动
title.en: In a joint statement, Five Eyes agencies warn AI models capable of taking down governments and businesses are mere months away, urging leaders to “act now”

title.zh: OpenAI发布更新版GPT-5.5-Cyber模型，并与Trail of Bits合作启动“修复地球”计划
title.en: OpenAI unveils an updated GPT-5.5-Cyber model, launches the Patch the Planet initiative in partnership with Trail of Bits to fix open source bugs, and more

summary.zh: 该计划旨在修复开源软件中的漏洞。

title.zh: 三星为韩国员工和全球DX部门员工推出ChatGPT Enterprise和Codex
title.en: Samsung rolls out ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex to all South Korean staff and global DX division staff; OpenAI calls it one of its largest enterprise deployments

summary.zh: OpenAI称这是其最大企业部署之一。

title.zh: 腾讯在微信中测试新AI助手“小微”，由WeLM和DeepSeek模型驱动
title.en: Tencent starts testing Xiaowei, its new AI assistant powered by WeLM and DeepSeek models, in its WeChat app in China, as part of its efforts to catch up in AI

summary.zh: 此举是腾讯在AI领域追赶的努力之一。

title.zh: Sakana AI推出Fugu多代理编排系统，声称Fugu Ultra在基准测试中媲美Fable和Mythos
title.en: Sakana AI launches Fugu, a multi-agent orchestration system accessible through a single model API, claiming Fugu Ultra matches Fable and Mythos on benchmarks

summary.zh: Fugu通过单一模型API提供访问。

title.zh: Air Space Intelligence赢得8.75亿美元FAA合同，开发AI工具优化航班轨迹
title.en: Air Space Intelligence won an $875M, 12-year FAA contract to develop AI tools that map flight trajectories and identify areas of congestion to reduce delays

summary.zh: 该工具旨在识别拥堵区域以减少航班延误。

title.zh: 消息称高通拟以约40亿美元收购AI芯片初创公司Modular
title.en: Sources: Qualcomm is in advanced talks to acquire Modular in a transaction valuing the AI chip startup at ~$4B, up from a $1.6B valuation in September 2025

summary.zh: Modular在2025年9月的估值为16亿美元。

title.zh: Nvidia发布Halos操作系统，专注安全性，适用于人形机器人
title.en: Nvidia unveils Halos, a safety-focused OS developed from autonomous vehicle tech and designed to run on IGX Thor hardware for humanoid robots, and opens a lab

summary.zh: Halos基于自动驾驶技术开发，运行于IGX Thor硬件上，同时Nvidia还开放了一个实验室。

title.zh: 上海Coowa计划在香港上市，估值超30亿美元
title.en: Sources: Shanghai-based Coowa, which builds embodied AI robots, plans to file a Hong Kong IPO; Coowa was valued at $3B+ after raising $600M+ in its latest round

summary.zh: Coowa专注于开发具备实体化AI的机器人，最近一轮融资超过6亿美元。

title.zh: Groq完成6.5亿美元融资，计划到2027年实现200MW产能
title.en: Groq raised $650M led by Disruptive and Infinitum after its Nvidia deal, aiming to hit 200 MW in capacity by the end of 2027, following a $750M raise in 2025

summary.zh: 融资由Disruptive和Infinitum领投，此前2025年曾筹集7.5亿美元。

title.zh: Upscale完成1.9亿美元A-1轮融资，估值达20亿美元
title.en: Upscale, which is building AI networking infrastructure to rival Cisco, raised a $190M Series A-1 at a $2B valuation, up from $1B after raising $200M in January

summary.zh: Upscale致力于构建与思科竞争的AI网络基础设施，今年1月曾融资2亿美元，估值10亿美元。

title.zh: 2026年国防科技公司融资达123亿美元，超2025年99.5亿美元
title.en: PitchBook: defense tech companies making drones, battlefield AI, and more raised $12.3B across 175 deals in 2026 so far, up from a $9.95B from 158 deals in 2025

summary.zh: PitchBook数据显示，2026年已有175笔交易，涉及无人机、战场AI等领域。

title.zh: S&P和IBM报告：2024年日本成为全球网络攻击最频繁目标
title.en: S&P and IBM: 22.4% of global cyberattacks in 2024 hit Japan, the most targeted country, as it tries to improve its legacy IT systems against AI-powered threats

summary.zh: 22.4%的全球网络攻击集中在日本，主要原因是其试图改进传统IT系统以应对AI驱动的威胁。
